headline: Traffic is healthy; paid social expands the opportunity set
executiveSummary: Human visits represent 84% of traffic. Facebook and Reddit add meaningful paid-social reach alongside Google Ads, while LinkedIn engagement is strongest for practical AI implementation content. OpenAI usage remains a measurable operating cost.
actions: Scale the Reddit Small Business AI campaign cautiously.
Improve conversion paths on the AI Growth landing page.
Reuse practical implementation themes across paid and organic channels.

visualizations.title: Traffic composition
visualizations.description: Sessions and identified bot traffic by visitor type.

visualizations.title: Paid channel spend
visualizations.description: Demonstration spend by paid acquisition channel.

sources.name: Traffic Properties
sources.summary: Human traffic accounts for 84% of sessions. The AI Growth service page leads entrances, while AI bot visibility is measurable and growing.

sources.name: Google Ads
sources.summary: Paid search produced 27 conversions at an $18.01 cost per conversion. AI Growth Search is the primary contributor.
insights: Conversion volume is concentrated in the AI Growth Search campaign.

sources.name: LinkedIn
sources.summary: LinkedIn reached 12,640 impressions and added 34 followers. Practical implementation content generated the strongest engagement.
insights: Practical AI growth systems was the strongest post.

sources.name: OpenAI Usage
sources.summary: OpenAI workloads issued 1,834 requests at an estimated $41.28 cost. Usage is concentrated in the primary reasoning model.

sources.name: Reddit Ads
sources.summary: Reddit Ads generated 19 conversions at an $11.51 cost per conversion, outperforming the sample paid-search acquisition cost.
insights: Small Business AI is the leading campaign.

sources.name: Facebook Ads
sources.summary: Facebook Ads produced broad paid-social reach with efficient click costs in the demonstration dataset.
insights: Link clicks account for most measured clicks.

footer: Demonstration data from GA4, Tracking Logs, Google Ads, LinkedIn, OpenAI Usage, Reddit Ads, and Facebook Ads. Not live production data.

promptProvenance.promptText: Combine every available source into the versioned TrafficAnalysis email report view model.
